name: safeflow
description: Безопасная платформа оркестрации AI-агентов для Claude Code. Локальная, прозрачная, без скрытых сетевых вызовов.

scripts.test: node --test test/memory.test.js test/migrations.test.js test/hybrid.test.js test/lifecycle.test.js test/consolidation.test.js test/planner.test.js test/security.paths.test.js test/security.validation.test.js

//overrides: Patched protobufjs and qs to address CVEs in transitive deps of @xenova/transformers (onnxruntime-web → onnx-proto → protobufjs). Upstream @xenova/transformers is partially deprecated; successor is huggingface/transformers.js. Revisit every 3-6 months: temporarily remove the overrides block, run 'rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install && npm audit --audit-level=high'. If clean — remove overrides permanently. If still vulnerable — keep. Added in v2.0.0 (PR #15). Caret ranges (^7.6.2) here are deliberate and differ from the exact pins the project policy requires for normal deps: security overrides intentionally use caret to auto-pull CVE patches within the same major, while package-lock.json still pins to an exact version for reproducible builds. NOTE: this comment lives at the top level, not inside overrides — npm parses every key inside overrides as a package name, so a comment key there breaks npm ci.
//security: Этот пакет НЕ имеет preinstall/postinstall/install скриптов. Установка только распаковывает файлы. Все зависимости — с фиксированными версиями (без ^ или ~). Никаких сетевых вызовов при установке.
